package.name: pgea_gripper
package.description: ROS 2 bridge for the DH-Robotics PGEA integrated gripper on the DOBOT CR5A. Serves a control_msgs/GripperCommand action for MoveIt and feeds finger joint states, using Modbus-RTU through the CR controller tool-RS485 gateway — by default via dobot_bringup_v4's services (transport:=bringup, works alongside the arm driver), or a direct Dashboard TCP client (transport:=dashboard, arm driver stopped) or PC USB-RS485 adapter (transport:=serial).
